# Contact brand icons

Retrieved 2026-10-04. These eight SVGs inherit `currentColor`; use `color: #0E8F78` on an inline SVG or its parent. In a 22px round button a 14px glyph fits cleanly. Preserve the viewBox and aspect ratio.

| File | Source | Brand origin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| facebook.svg | Simple Icons 16.34.0 | https://www.meta.com/brand/resources/facebook/logo/ |
| linkedin.svg | Font Awesome Free 7.3.1 | https://brand.linkedin.com/in-logo |
| tiktok.svg | Simple Icons 16.34.0 | https://developers.tiktok.com/docs/en/getting-started-design-guidelines |
| youtube.svg | Simple Icons 16.34.0 | https://brand.youtube/ |
| whatsapp.svg | Official WhatsApp 2026 glyph | https://www.meta.com/brand/resources/whatsapp/whatsapp-brand/ |
| x.svg | Official X logo ZIP | https://about.x.com/content/dam/about-twitter/x/brand-toolkit/x-logo.zip |
| pinterest.svg | Simple Icons 16.34.0 | https://business.pinterest.com/brand-guidelines/ |
| github.svg | Official current GitHub Invertocat | https://brand.github.com/GitHub_Logos.zip |

Original path data and viewBoxes are retained; sizing and monochrome fill are the only visual presentation changes. `sources.json` records exact package commits, URLs and original asset names.

Simple Icons is CC0-1.0 at package level. Font Awesome SVG icons are CC BY 4.0; keep the attribution comment in `linkedin.svg` when inlining. The Font Awesome license notice is in `FONT-AWESOME-LICENSE.txt`; the Simple Icons CC0 notice is recorded in `sources.json`. Brand-owned downloads remain subject to their brand guidelines, and package licenses do not release trademarks.

LinkedIn's official download is PNG; the SVG comes from Font Awesome's own source. Facebook's official pack is PNG/AI, and TikTok's pack does not supply a standalone monochrome glyph SVG, so the corresponding Simple Icons paths are used. GitHub uses the revised 2025+ mark and WhatsApp uses the updated 2026 phone glyph.

The requested green recoloring is supported by currentColor; several brands restrict logo color in their guidelines. This prepared SVG set does not imply that a custom green is an approved brand color.
